description.value: Kokoro Ramen is a craft Japanese ramen restaurant in East Vancouver, founded in 2016 by a team of culinary professionals with formal ramen and udon school training in Japan. The restaurant emphasizes authentic, health-conscious ramen made from fresh ingredients, and has expanded into retail with frozen ramen kits sold at grocery stores across the Lower Mainland. Both dine-in and takeout are available, making it a sit-down or grab-and-go option for cyclists on Victoria Drive.
